rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's 'Political Context' page says Mbeki remained President for a second term 'until September 2008, when he was recalled by the ruling party (ANC)', and that 'President Mbeki was succeeded by President Kgalema Motlanthe on 25 September 2008'.

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same page says 'Jacob Zuma, who was inaugurated as President of South Africa on 9 May 2009, is the fourth President of the democratic South Africa'.
